controls.description: Prepare evidence for component-maintainer coordination without automatic external contact.
Define identifiable PSIRT single point of contact and deterministic intake/triage.
Prepare structured impacted-user/all-user notifications for AEV/severe incidents.
Prepare fixed-vulnerability disclosure/advisory evidence with delayed-disclosure justification support.
Represent and validate enforceable coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy.
Represent vulnerability-reporting contact and information-sharing workflow.
Expose manufacturer/contact information in M15 user-information evidence.
Expose vulnerability reporting contact and CVD policy location.
